name: 10023 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10023 (New York) has 695 nonprofit organizations. 272 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 228 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10023 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10023 (New York) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
